_comment: What the estate costs and when each line renews. The LIST of VPS and domains is derived from the servers themselves — do not maintain it here. This file supplies only what a dump cannot know: the price and the renewal date. Keys are vps:<server-id> and domain:<registrable-domain>. Anything else you pay for (an API plan, a mail plan) can be added with any key and a label. A line left at null renders as 'not recorded', which is the point: it names the bill nobody is tracking.
note: Hosting is the fixed floor: it does not move with WhatsApp volume, which is what the bars below it do.
